summary: Adds a root/operator command that transactionally rotates the PostgreSQL role, Django .env, and updater pgpass credential under one shared lock: fail-closed preflight, service-quiescence enforcement, client-side SCRAM derivation behind a verified PostgreSQL logging/pgAudit suppression boundary, durable crash recovery, bounded Django/psql/pg_dump validation, and rollback before validated-new cleanup. Backup and Update Center admission honor the same lock. No schema or protected-runtime change.
